text.p: PRAVDA - The opposition Party of Democratic Left (SDL) said it would not support moves leading to early elections.

NARODNA OBRODA - The net internal debt of the Slovak government to the domestic banking sector totalled 59.7 billion crowns as of September 30. The debt to the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) totalled 15.4 billion crowns, while debts to commercial banks totalled 44.3 billion.

- The NBS said it was now reviewing grounds of the appeal by steel maker VSZ after the central bank rejected a VSZ request to increase its holding in bank IRB over the 15 percent limit. The NBS and VSZ will hold negotiations over the issue next week.

- The independent trade unions of medical doctors (LOZ) said their decision on holding a protest strike depend on whether the government fulfils its promise of a 35 percent pay rise from the beginning of next year.
- SES Tlmace a.s., an engineering company producing equipment for the energy sector, said its gross profit for the first nine months of this year totalled 40.6 million crowns.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The number of employees in industry totalled around 620,000 as of August 31, an increase of 0.4 percent over the same period last year.
- Shoe maker JAS Bardejov said it had, so far this year, invested some 90 million crowns in building its market network in states of the former Soviet Union and rump Yugoslavia.
